name: side-panel
blurb: Narrow panel expands horizontally to reveal navigation with spring easing.
description: A responsive side panel that animates from narrow to wide (97% width) using tween easing. Content height animates with spring physics. Measures child height dynamically with react-use-measure. Dark themed with rounded right edge.
use_when: You need a collapsible navigation panel that feels natural on desktop and tablets.
avoid_when: Mobile-first experiences — the horizontal expansion may be cramped on narrow screens.
a11y: Custom button handled via renderButton prop. You must add ARIA labels and keyboard support yourself.
